      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/28/egypt-lina-attalah-mada-masr-press-freedom-clampdown</link>

News from the US, Europe, Asia Pacific, Africa, Middle East, America</description><link>https://www.france24.com/en/</link><lastBuildDate>Thu, 29 Oct 2026 02:54:37 GMT</lastBuildDate><atom:link href="https://www.france24.com/en/rss" rel="self" type="application/rss+xml"/><item><category>Europe</category><title>Canada and EU drop associate membership plan in bid to deepen ties</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261029-canada-and-eu-drop-associate-membership-plan-in-bid-to-deepen-ties</link><description>
Canada and the European Union will pursue closer ties but have dropped a proposal for associate EU membership, according to a joint declaration ahead of Thursday’s summit in Montreal. Prime Minister Mark Carney is seeking to reduce Canada’s reliance on the US, despite warnings from Donald Trump.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/de478f98-d32c-11f1-b496-47de50b3c1e4/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26264053021764.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/de478f98-d32c-11f1-b496-47de50b3c1e4/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26264053021764.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">96422c38-d333-11f1-b24a-0f068fd21a05</guid><pubDate>Thu, 29 Oct 2026 00:56:33 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/de478f98-d32c-11f1-b496-47de50b3c1e4/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26264053021764.jpg">© Pascal Bastien, AP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Spain rail crash came after train ordered to go in error: minister</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/spain-rail-crash-came-after-train-ordered-to-go-in-error-minister</link><description>
A rail collision in Spain that claimed at least 68 lives on Wednesday came after a train was ordered to go in "error" despite a technical failure that halted all services, the transport minister said. The first findings about the accident in the central region of Castilla-La Mancha are likely to revive questions about rail safety in Spain after another high-speed collision in January killed 46 people. FRANCE 24's James Vasina reports.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/cba1ef0c-d2d5-11f1-a78f-47de50b3c1e4/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26301416185342.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/cba1ef0c-d2d5-11f1-a78f-47de50b3c1e4/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26301416185342.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">20c597ac-d31e-11f1-b582-43cd9a142c8b</guid><pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 22:30:17 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category>A propos</category><title>Flavio Bolsonaro claims he is Brazil's true leader after fleeing to US</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/a-propos/20261028-flavio-bolsonaro-claims-he-is-brazil-s-true-leader-after-fleeing-to-us</link><description>
Brazil's defeated right-wing presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro insisted Wednesday he is his country's rightful leader after arriving in the United States to start a self-imposed exile. Bolsonaro's defiance on fleeing to Florida signaled continued upheaval for Brazil, where leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva won a dramatic runoff election Sunday. FRANCE 24's Sharon Gaffney speaks with Fabio de Sa e Silva, Associate Professor of International Studies at the University of Oklahoma. He says that an attempt by Bolsonaro to turn a domestic dispute into a wider international issue "will not be successful", explaining that he is likely going to be "losing the grip of the opposition, there is a vacuum now that others will seek to occupy" and that it's unlikely that the United States will "get involved into questioning the results of the Brazilian election".

<![CDATA[ Latest from Space.com ]]> https://www.space.com/feeds.xml Wed, 28 Oct 2026 23:02:12 +0000 en <![CDATA[ On this day in space! Oct. 28, 1971: Britain launches its 1st satellite Prospero into space on a Black Arrow rocket ]]>

On Oct. 28, 1971, the United Kingdom launched its first satellite. The satellite was named Prospero, but it was also known as the X-3.

This wasn't Britain's first satellite, but it was the first and only one the British space program launched with one of its own rockets. The first six British satellites all launched from the United States on NASA rockets. Prospero launched on a carrier rocket called the Black Arrow.

The Prospero mission was the fourth and final flight of a Black Arrow rocket. Prospero was designed to study how the environment in space affects communications satellites. It tested things solar cells and telemetry systems, and even had a micrometeoroid detector that would determine small particles in space posed a threat to the spacecraft.

The mission lifted off from the Woomera Range Complex in Australia. While the launch was a success, the rocket's final stage bumped into the satellite after it separated, and the collision broke one of Prospero's four radio antennas. But the satellite still worked, and it remained operational until 1973.

Why it mattered

The launch of Prospero is etched in the history books of British spaceflight. To this date, it remains the first and last British satellite ever launched on a native rocket built in the United Kingdom.

The 66-kilogram satellite launched on a three-stage Black Arrow R-3 rocket and flew in an elliptical orbit that ranged between 522 km to 1,300 km above the Earth. The rocket itself was based on the smaller Black Knight research rocket and stood nearly 13 meters tall. While the launch was successful, the Black Arrow program, which had seen two failures and two successes, was ultimately canceled.

The Prospero satellite, meanwhile, operated in orbit for two years, with regular communications ending in 1973, though it was contacted at least once each year through 1996, according to the BBC.

The satellite remains in orbit today, its legacy such that at least one company - the Scotland-based space startup Skyrora, has announced plans to retrieve Prospero in orbit and deorbit in Earth's atmosphere.

That Skyrora plan, announced in 2021, would use the company's space tug to rendezvous with the defunct Prospero, latch onto it and pull it from space. The company aims to launch its Skyrora XL rocket out of a Saxavord Spaceport in Scotland.

"By recovering Prospero, we are not only coming together as a space nation and taking responsibility for what we have launched into orbit, but also confirming our commitment to the sustainable use of outer space," Volodymyr Levykin, Skyrora founder and CEO, said at the time.

Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.

]]> <![CDATA[ 5 days beneath the waves: What it's like to live in an underwater 'space station' ]]> Living underwater was surprisingly peaceful. It was in many ways exactly what I imagine living on Mars would be like one day. There were no humans around us, except for my three SEA STAR crewmembers and me. Apart from the human noises we made, we couldn't hear anything other than the life support systems keeping us alive submerged 22 feet (7 meters) below the surface.

We were living in these extreme conditions to study the challenges astronauts may face on long-duration space missions. Since performing research in space is still rare and expensive, there are numerous facilities around the world that focus on recreating space-like conditions on Earth. One of those stations is the Jules' Undersea Lab, where the SEA STAR simulated space mission took place.

This underwater habitat was called "La Chalupa" when it was built in the 1970s. Its purpose was to allow divers to live and perform research as aquanauts — people who spend more than 24 hours underwater in a so-called state of saturation. Today, the Jules' Undersea Lab is located near Key Largo, in Florida. However, it was originally designed to be mobile — inside a barge 20 feet wide and 60 feet long (6 to 18 meters).

The aquanauts could choose an ideal site for their research expeditions underwater and then have the facility be submerged. They did that by flooding most of its inside space, turning it from a boat to a submarine. Once their work was done, they could remove the water and move "La Chalupa" to another location.

Unfortunately, the funding to keep this facility running ran out over time, and it was moved one last time to its current home. Since then, the now Jules' Undersea Lab served as the research station for tens of different aquanaut missions, including a NASA 30-day project and two missions that set world records for the longest time living underwater (73 and 100 days).

On the inside, the underwater station is made up of a galley with a kitchen and dining/work area. Next to it there is a basic toilet, shower and the "moon pool," which is the equivalent of a door to get inside the habitat. The final area is the bedroom with two bunk beds, which can be split in the middle to create two bedrooms and provide additional privacy. Three windows throughout the habitat provide its dwellers with a view of a mostly green outside world.

To start our SEA STAR simulated space mission, we waved goodbye to our Mission Control team on "Earth" and dove down to enter the Jules' Undersea Lab through the "moon pool" at 25 feet (7.6 m) underwater. After that, we did not return to the surface again until five days later. We lived and worked the whole time underwater, performing our space-related research and "spacewalks" (a.k.a. exploration dives in scuba gear).

We were able to survive all this time in such a challenging environment thanks to a number of important life support systems keeping us alive. The communications and umbilical support cables (providing air, fresh water and power) for the habitat were originally supplied by NASA. All the piping and fittings are inside the submerged barge, protected from the air-sea interface and from encrusting marine creatures. There was also a direct line to Mission Control "on Earth" to help us in case of any emergencies.

Our schedule kept us busy all day every day to simulate what astronauts experience on the International Space Station (ISS). All four of us on the SEA STAR crew had research projects that we were responsible for, as well as daily tasks. These tasks involved cooking, medical checkups, cognitive tests, maintenance work and taking care of unexpected issues. As the Commander of the crew, I also made sure everyone was on top of their work and addressed any problems that came up.

We performed "spacewalks" in between all those other activities. They were pretty physically exhausting, which meant that we did not do additional exercise during the mission. I have been the Commander of 40 simulated space missions, and normally we exercise for at least an hour or two during each mission, just like astronauts on the ISS. Nonetheless, the pressure in the Jules' Undersea Lab was approximately twice as high as it was on the surface at sea level. This caused the crew to experience additional stress to their bodies, which is why no further exercise was required.

Even though our hands were full with activities during the mission, none of us felt particularly stressed out. Whether it was because of the effects of the pressurized conditions or thanks to good planning, we actually enjoyed our time living underwater. One of the nice surprises of the mission was that the food wasn't too bad, either. We were allowed to use a small crock pot, which meant we could eat soups, stews and overnight oats. Small joys like that boosted our spirits immensely.

Having said all that, the Jules' Undersea Lab did also make the isolation from our lives on Earth feel very realistic. While we didn't have a view of Earth like the astronauts on the ISS, our very green view of a completely different world outside our windows gave us an impression of living on another planet. It was the alien nature of our lifestyle 22 feet underwater and all the challenges that came with it that made this mission feel Mars-like. Our daily schedule grounded us, the extreme environment around us kept us on our toes and our scientific exploration helped us reach new frontiers.

]]> <![CDATA[ Meet Apeiron, Virgin Galactic's 1st 'Delta-class' space plane ]]> Virgin Galactic has officially unveiled the first space plane in its next-gen "Delta" line, and announced the results of the worldwide vote to choose its name.

Spaceship Apeiron will be the first Delta-class vehicle, Virgin Galactic revealed on Wednesday (Oct. 28). Apeiron (pronounced "A'-per-on," according to the announcement) takes its name from the ancient Greek word meaning "boundless," and was selected through a public poll that drew votes from thousands of people across 83 countries and six continents.

The reveal comes on the same day that the space plane is scheduled to be flown from its manufacturing facility in Mesa, Arizona, to Spaceport America in New Mexico, where the vehicle will undergo final preparations before beginning flight tests.

Apeiron was one of four finalist names that Virgin Galactic narrowed down from a list of 276 employee-submitted suggestions. After the public weighed in, Apeiron came out on top over Horizon, Explorer and Ascend.

“Apeiron, the Boundless, captures the ambition of human spaceflight and the possibilities it opens for humanity," Virgin Galactic CEO Michael Golglazier said in a company statement. "The extraordinary response to the public vote made choosing this name even more meaningful."

The shiny new space plane will be attached to Virgin Galactic's VMS Eve carrier aircraft for its journey to Spaceport America, where engineers will complete work on its avionics software ahead of Apeiron's first flight tests and eventual operational missions.

The new Delta-class vehicle replaces Virgin's earlier space plane model, VSS Unity, which flew seven suborbital missions during its operational lifetime between the summers of 2023 and 2024. The company suspended VSS Unity flights to focus efforts on Apeiron's development, and now hopes to begin flying customers again in mid-2027.

Once they're in regular operation, Virgin plans to fly each of its Delta-class vehicles as many as eight times a month. A second Delta-class space plane is already under construction and is expected to join Apeiron at Spaceport America around the same time that Virgin restarts flying passengers, about 675 of whom are still waiting in line with tickets for a seat on one of the company's suborbital jaunts, according to the company's Q2 2026 SEC filing.

Now, more than 100 of those future space travelers are beginning their initial preparations for flight, with more ticketholders expected to follow once Virgin brings the second Delta-class vehicle into service. When the company began selling seats aboard its space plane in 2014, when VSS Unity was still under construction, tickets were priced around $200,000. Today, that price has jumped to $850,000 per seat, according to a report by Latte.

Like its predecessor, Apeiron and future Delta-class vehicles are designed for short, suborbital spaceflights, and are not capable of reaching orbit around Earth. They fly above the internationally recognized boundary of space, the 100-kilometer-high (62 miles) Karman line, and provide those onboard with several minutes of weightlessness and great views of the planet below.

Virgin Galactic plans to share further details about its upcoming flight tests during its November earnings call.

Virgin is one of two American companies that have flown paying customers to suborbital space and back. The other, Blue Origin, suspended its flights earlier this year to focus on helping land NASA astronauts on the moon.

A U.S. military intelligence agency has released an incredible new photograph of China's secretive space plane, showing it docked to another spacecraft in orbit.

The photograph was taken in 2024 by Vantor's WorldView 3 satellite, from a distance of 56 miles (90 kilometers). Ground-based observers have previously photographed Shenlong in orbit, but this new photo from Vantor, taken from space, reveals new details about the mysterious spacecraft in stunning clarity, with a resolution of 4.5 centimeters (1.8 inches) per pixel. The image was included in a new report released by the Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA) assessing the scope and breadth of adversary threats in space.

In the image, the robotic Shenlong space plane can be seen docked to another satellite that has its solar panels deployed. It's not yet known which satellite that may have been. Shenlong's payload bay doors can also be seen in the photograph, in an open position.

Those payload doors may offer clues about what Shenlong is doing on its fourth mission, which launched in February 2026. China's space agency has stated only that Shenlong helps test technologies that "will pave the way for more convenient and affordable round-trip methods for the peaceful use of space in the future."

But observers have seen Shenlong release other objects while in orbit, such as in June 2026, when American space intelligence company LeoLabs reported that itdetected a new object in the vicinity of the space plane.

"Following additional observations across our global network and analysis via LeoLabs Delta, we have independently cataloged this object and assessed with high confidence that it was released from the Chinese space plane," LeoLabs stated at the time. "This activity is consistent with sub-satellite deployments conducted by the space plane in previous missions."

A similar event happened during Shenlong's third mission, which ended in 2024. On its second mission in 2023, the space plane also released an object and may have conducted what are known as proximity and rendezvous operations, in which two spacecraft maneuver close to one another.

It may have been that the spacecraft was releasing unnecessary hardware before landing, however. Like all things military space, few details have been released to the public about Shenlong's operations.

The United States, similarly, operates a secretive robotic space plane, the Boeing-built X-37B, and rarely releases concrete details about its capabilities or its missions. In February 2025, the U.S. Space Force released its first photo of the X-37B in space, offering a rare glimpse at the space plane in operation. The photo appeared to show it in a high Earth orbit with what appear to be its payload bay doors open.

In 2023, Space Force released its first official painting, depicting an X-37B-like space plane in orbit above Earth, intercepting another satellite.

With China and the United States currently jockeying for the lead in what many observers have called a new Space Race, rare glimpses like these images may be a way of militaries and intelligence agencies of teasing capabilities without fully revealing them to the public.

]]> <![CDATA[ Astronomers found a mysterious object beyond Neptune, and it could be a new dwarf planet ]]>

The powerful Vera Rubin Observatory has spotted what seems to be a dwarf planet circling the sun in the frigid depths beyond Neptune.

The icy object, known as 2026 ED138, is likely between 600 and 1500 kilometers (373 to 972 miles) wide, scientists say. It's therefore probably big enough to be sculpted into a sphere by its own gravity — a key characteristic that separates dwarf planets from asteroids and other small space rocks.

And if 2026 ED138 is indeed a dwarf planet, that's a pretty big deal, as astronomers have confirmed just five of them to date: Pluto, Ceres, Eris, Haumea and Makemake.

2026 ED138 was discovered by Matthew Holman, who works at the Center for Astrophysics | Harvard & Smithsonian (CfA). The big moment came on Oct. 13, when Holman was running previously collected Rubin data through a search code that he developed with his CfA colleague Kevin Napier.

That search revealed a mysterious object beyond Neptune's orbit. Despite its immense distance from the sun, this body was relatively bright, suggesting that it's larger than the average trans-Neptunian object.

"My first reaction was one of excited disbelief," Holman said in a statement on Tuesday (Oct. 27), the day the discovery of 2026 ED138 was announced. "Objects like this are very rare, so I immediately started checking whether I or the code had done something wrong."

Those checks involved a thorough search through Rubin's catalog. And that catalog is pretty heft, even though Rubin is a pretty new scope.

The Vera Rubin Observatory sits atop Cerro Pachón, an 8,799-foot-tall (2,682 meters) mountain in northern Chile, and features a primary mirror 28 feet (8.4 m) wide. The scope achieved first light in April 2025 and began its main project, the 10-year-long Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST), in June of this year.

During the LSST, Rubin images the entire southern sky every few days using a 3.2-gigapixel camera, the largest digital camera ever built for astronomy. This work creates a high-resolution time-lapse "movie" that can reveal a great deal about the cosmos.

For example, astronomers think Rubin will shed light on dark energy and dark matter, the mysterious stuff that together makes up most of the universe's mass-energy budget. Its observations will also serve as a solar system inventory, helping scientists map out our cosmic backyard like never before. Rubin has already discovered more than 11,000 new asteroids, for example, with many more surely to come.

The LSST inventory will likely include a number of new dwarf planets as well — including, possibly, 2026 ED138. For the object definitely exists: Holman and his colleague Mario Jurić, who works at the University of Washington and serves as Rubin Solar System Lead Scientist, found that Rubin spotted 2026 ED138 30 separate times on 20 nights between March 4 and July 11 of this year.

And further digging revealed that the Dark Energy Camera (DEC), an instrument on the Víctor M. Blanco 4-meter Telescope at the Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory in Chile, also spotted 2026 ED138. Indeed, DEC observations of the object go all the way back to 2016.

The data show that 2026 ED138's orbit is tilted by about 25 degrees relative to the plane of the solar system. It therefore likely had a gravitational interaction with Neptune, which knocked it off kilter, scientists say.

2026 ED138 currently lies about 46 astronomical units (AU) from the sun. (One AU is the Earth-sun distance — about 93 million miles, or 150 million kilometers). This puts it beyond Pluto's average distance from the sun, which is roughly 40 AU.

There is still much to learn about the object, however. For example, we won't know whether or not it's a dwarf planet until astronomers nail down its size. And that will require observations in infrared light, the range of wavelengths that NASA's James Webb Space Telescope is optimized for.

So stay tuned: There's doubtless more news about 2026 ED138 coming, and Rubin could turn up more worlds like it in the coming months and years.

"If confirmed as a dwarf planet, ED138 would join a very small family of worlds," Holman said. "Rubin will image the whole southern sky again and again for 10 years, so any others hiding in the places earlier surveys skipped are now within reach."

]]> <![CDATA[ Black holes can split in two — but only if they spin at extreme speeds ]]> Scientists have long known that when two black holes collide, they merge to create a more massive black hole. These events are so violent that they set the very fabric of space ringing with ripples called gravitational waves.

Now, new research suggests that the opposite may happen, too: single black holes may be able to split in two. But this can only happen if that progenitor black hole is spinning at maximum possible speed. That speed prevents the black holes from immediately falling back on each other.

There are physical laws in place that would usually prevent black holes from splitting in two; the team behind this research investigated whether there are conditions in which these laws can be temporarily bypassed.

One of the key aspects of physics that prevents black holes from bifurcating comes from thermodynamics. Black holes possess a characteristic called "entropy," which is essentially a measure of disorder within a system.

Imagine a toddler's crayon box. When entropy is low, the crayons are neatly arranged by color. As entropy is increased, the crayons are scattered and no longer in order. To get the crayons back in order, it requires a parent to put energy into the system and neatly reorder the crayons. In other words, the entropy of a system can't be reduced without some intervention and energy being added from outside that system. Parenting would be a little easier if it could.

A black hole splitting in two would represent a decrease in entropy, strongly disfavored by the laws of thermodynamics, but only if the black hole is not rotating. The situation could be different for a rapidly rotating black hole.

This team of scientists found that a loophole exists for such a black hole.

"The two resulting black holes must also be able to separate rather than immediately fall back together," team member Francesco Sannino of the University of Naples Federico II in Italy said in a statement. "When we include this requirement, the window largely closes again, except possibly for black holes rotating close to their maximum possible rate."

Black hole trousers?

The team calculated just how such a black hole split could occur, finding that the division of the black hole's outer boundary, or "event horizon," proceeds in an oddly trouser-like shape, with one resulting black hole slipping down each "leg."

They termed this "pair-of-pants topologies."

The researchers also determined that a split is more likely to take place if one of the resultant black holes is considerably smaller than its newly born twin.

"We cannot yet give a single probability for a black hole to split. It depends on how gravity behaves beyond Einstein's theory, and we are working to quantify this," Sannino said. "We expect small primordial black holes to be more prone to splitting than much larger astrophysical black holes."

Sannino added that such black hole splits may be detectable in high-energy light called gamma-rays.

"We may detect a split indirectly: gamma-ray telescopes such as Fermi-LAT can search for signals from tiny black-hole fragments that might form during mergers," the researcher concluded.

The team's research was published on Oct. 22 in the journal Physical Review D.

   <description>České vysoké školy potřebují silnější vedení, užší propojení s byznysem a větší otevřenost zahraničním talentům. <description>Český startup BottleCap AI, za kterým stojí Tomá&#353; Mikolov a Jaroslav Beck, nedávno vydal vylep&#353;enou verzi AI modelu Nvidia Nemotron. Jeden vylep&#353;uje dal&#353;í verzi modelu Qwen od Alibaby a druhý je zlep&#353;enou verzí modelu Gemma od Googlu, respektive sekce DeepMind.</description>

 <description>Nejméně 68 lidí zemřelo po srážce dvou vysokorychlostních vlaků poblíž španělského města Urda v provincii Toledo.  <description>Ve Spojených státech zesiluje odpor proti výstavbě datových center, která jsou nezbytná pro rozvoj umělé inteligence. Jejich provoz vyžaduje značné množství elektřiny a vody, místní obyvatelé si navíc stěžují na hluk a další dopady na životní prostředí i lidské zdraví. Nakolik se výstavba datových center promítá do kampaně před listopadovými volbami do Kongresu? A proč ji navzdory odporu části vlastních příznivců podporuje Donald Trump?</description>

 <description>Slovensko je opět schopné bránit svůj vzdušný prostor vlastními silami. Oznámil to slovenský prezident Peter Pellegrini. Slovensko po ruské invazi na Ukrajinu v roce 2022 vyřadilo z výzbroje zastaralé stíhačky MiG-29 ze sovětské éry a předalo je Kyjevu. S ochranou slovenského vzdušného prostoru pak začali pomáhat spojenci včetně Česka. Už v roce 2018 si Slovensko objednalo 14 nových stíhaček F-16 Block 70, z nichž většina již je v zemi.</description>

 <description>Americkým republikánům hrozí, že po více než třiceti letech prohrají volby v Texasu – a že tím přijdou i o kontrolu nad federálním Senátem. V primárkách totiž vybrali za kandidáta státního prokurátora Kena Paxtona, kterého provází několik skandálů.  <description>Při srážce dvou vysokorychlostních vlaků v centrálním Španělsku zemřelo nejméně 68 lidí. S odvoláním na místní úřady o tom informoval španělský deník El País.  <description>Britský král Karel III. uznal utrpení a nespravedlnosti způsobené otroctvím v Karibiku. Prohlásil, že o této otázce budou příští týden jednat představitelé zemí britského Společenství národů (Commonwealth), jehož hlavou je britský panovník. Karel III. to uvedl během návštěvy Baham, která je součástí jeho cesty po karibské oblasti, napsala agentura Reuters. Karibské státy dlouhodobě požadují, aby Británie oběti otroctví a kolonialismu odškodnila.</description>

 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/jednani-mezi-ukrajinou-ruskem-a-usa-se-uskutecni-v-listopadu-trump-ocekava_2610280843_eml</link>
 <description>Ruský prezident Vladimir Putin a jeho ukrajinský protějšek Volodymyr Zelenskyj by se velmi brzy mohli sejít. Novinářům to bez upřesnění řekl americký prezident Donald Trump, napsala ve středu agentura AFP. Trump rovněž podle portálu Kyiv Post prohlásil, že Spojené státy činí v úsilí ukončit válku mezi Ruskem a Ukrajinou značné pokroky.</description>

<item>
 <title>Netanjahu v průběžných výsledcích parlamentních voleb vede, většinu nemá</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/po-secteni-42-procent-hlasu-vede-v-izraelskych-volbach-vladni-blok-informoval_2610280624_eml</link>
 <description>Po sečtení více než tří čtvrtin hlasů v izraelských volbách vede blok premiéra Benjamina Netanjahua, většinu v parlamentu ale podle všeho mít nebude. Podle serveru The Times of Israel (ToI) může získat 54 křesel, zatímco hlavní opoziční uskupení 47 mandátů. Zbylých 19 křesel by po sečtení 76,8 procenta hlasů získaly strany vedené převážně izraelskými Araby. Pro většinu je ve 120členném Knesetu potřeba 61 křesel.</description>

Sedmadvacetiletý muž se po odhalení pokusil ostrahu fyzicky napadnout a agresivně se choval i po příjezdu městské policie. Nakonec skončil v rukou policie státní.</description></item><item><title>Boulder Point zdvojnásobil svou velikost. Lezení přitom není jen pro sportovce</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/sport/904150-boulder-point-zdvojnasobil-svou-velikost-lezeni-pritom-neni-jen-pro-sportovce.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/sport/904150-boulder-point-zdvojnasobil-svou-velikost-lezeni-pritom-neni-jen-pro-sportovce.html</guid><pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 17:54:00 +0100</pubDate><category>Sport</category><description>Liberecké lezecké centrum Boulder Point vstoupilo do nové éry. Osm let od svého otevření rozšířilo své prostory a dnes nabízí 2 000 metrů čtverečních pro bouldering. Chce vytvářet místo, kam se lidé rádi vracejí nejen kvůli lezení.</description></item><item><title>Na průčelí baziliky v Jablonném v Podještědí se vrátila další kamenná socha</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/kultura/904298-na-pruceli-baziliky-v-jablonnem-v-podjestedi-se-navrati-dalsi-kamenna-socha.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/kultura/904298-na-pruceli-baziliky-v-jablonnem-v-podjestedi-se-navrati-dalsi-kamenna-socha.html</guid><pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 16:00:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Kultura</category><description>Na průčelí baziliky svatého Vavřince a svaté Zdislavy v Jablonném v Podještědí na Liberecku se v úterý  vrátila třetí z pěti soch. Opět jde o kopii původní pískovcové sochy, kterou před třemi staletími vytvořil barokní sochař Franz Bienert. Originály nelze kvůli špatnému stavu na balustrádu vrátit.</description></item><item><title>Světový den spoření slaví 102 let. Víte, jak jsou vaše úspory chráněné?</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/903749-svetovy-den-sporeni-slavi-102-let-vite-jak-jsou-vase-uspory-chranene.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/903749-svetovy-den-sporeni-slavi-102-let-vite-jak-jsou-vase-uspory-chranene.html</guid><pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 13:54:00 +0100</pubDate><category>Společnost</category><description>Už 102 let si připomínáme na konci října Světový den spoření. Jeho původním cílem bylo povzbudit lidi k vytváření úspor a posílit důvěru ve finanční instituce. Dnes máme pro ukládání a zhodnocování peněz mnohem více možností než naši předkové.</description></item><item><title>Nádherný výhled po 70 letech. Na Javorníku slavnostně otevřeli novou rozhlednu</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904296-nadherny-vyhled-po-70-letech-na-javorniku-slavnostne-otevreli-novou-rozhlednu.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904296-nadherny-vyhled-po-70-letech-na-javorniku-slavnostne-otevreli-novou-rozhlednu.html</guid><pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 13:00:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Na Javorníku u Liberce se ve středu 28. října slavnostně otevřela nová rozhledna u hotelu Obří sud. Nabízí nejvýše položený vyhlídkový ochoz v kraji a výhled z výšky více než 34 metrů. Přestože oficiální zahájení proběhlo dnes, ve zkušebním provozu ji během předchozího měsíce navštívily tisíce lidí.</description></item><item><title>Vlastní zkušenost místo diplomu? Peer může pomoci i ublížit</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904207-vlastni-zkusenost-misto-diplomu-peer-muze-pomoci-i-ublizit.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904207-vlastni-zkusenost-misto-diplomu-peer-muze-pomoci-i-ublizit.html</guid><pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:08:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Markéta Hamerníková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Prošel si depresí, závislostí nebo poruchou příjmu potravy a teď pomáhá lidem, kteří jsou tam, kde byl kdysi on. Takzvaní peer konzultanti přinášejí do péče o duševní zdraví něco, co se nedá vystudovat – vlastní zkušenost. Právě ta ale může být zároveň rizikem.</description></item><item><title>Československo slaví 108 let od svého vzniku. Co se stalo 28. října?</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904205-ceskoslovensko-slavi-108-let-od-sveho-vzniku-co-se-stalo-28-rijna.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904205-ceskoslovensko-slavi-108-let-od-sveho-vzniku-co-se-stalo-28-rijna.html</guid><pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:30:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Petr Roubíček</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>28. říjen – pro někoho jen další státní svátek, pro druhé chvíle, kdy je dobré připomenout si vznik samostatného Československého státu. Jednalo se o jeden z nástupnických států rozpadlého Rakousko-Uherska. Tehdejší Československo zahrnovalo území Čech, Moravy, Slezka, Slovenska a Podkarpatské Rusi.</description></item><item><title>Revoluce v jablonecké nemocnici: V pondělí začne fungovat nový urgentní příjem</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/zdravi/904265-revoluce-v-jablonecke-nemocnici-v-pondeli-zacne-fungovat-novy-urgentni-prijem.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/zdravi/904265-revoluce-v-jablonecke-nemocnici-v-pondeli-zacne-fungovat-novy-urgentni-prijem.html</guid><pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 07:00:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Zdraví</category><description>Nemocnice v Jablonci nad Nisou spouští 2. listopadu 2026 provoz moderního urgentního příjmu za 66 milionů korun. Pacientům z celého regionu přinese okamžité roztřídění podle závažnosti stavu, osm pohodlných expektačních lůžek i konec zbytečného bloudění a čekání v přeplněných chodbách.</description></item><item><title>„Rozhodnutí ve mně už nějakou dobu zrálo.“ Poslanec David Pražák vystupuje z ANO</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/politika/904260-rozhodnuti-ve-mne-uz-nejakou-dobu-zralo-poslanec-david-prazak-vystoupil-z-ano.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/politika/904260-rozhodnuti-ve-mne-uz-nejakou-dobu-zralo-poslanec-david-prazak-vystoupil-z-ano.html</guid><pubDate>Tue, 27 Oct 2026 20:17:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Politika</category><description>Po jedenácti letech se rozhodl poslanec, zastupitel Libereckého kraje a Semil David Pražák vystoupit z politického hnutí ANO 2011. Spolu s ním se ke stejnému kroku rozhodli i další nově zvolení zastupitelé Semil na kandidátce ANO Semily. Nově budou fungovat jako nezávislí.</description></item><item><title>Jak budou mít obchody otevřeno 28. října? Přehled před svátečním nákupem</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904167-jak-budou-mit-obchody-otevreno-28-rijna-prehled-pred-svatecnim-nakupem.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/904167-jak-budou-mit-obchody-otevreno-28-rijna-prehled-pred-svatecnim-nakupem.html</guid><pubDate>Tue, 27 Oct 2026 20:01:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Markéta Hamerníková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Na větší nákup bude potřeba vyrazit předem. Ve středu 28. října musí většina obchodů s prodejní plochou nad 200 metrů čtverečních zavřít. Menší prodejny mohou otevřít, výjimku mají také čerpací stanice, lékárny nebo vybrané obchody na nádražích.</description></item></channel></rss>

]]> Šluknovská liga 2026/2027 – futsal https://www.vybezek.eu/296177-sluknovska-liga-2026-2027-futsal/ Wed, 21 Oct 2026 22:03:22 +0000 https://www.vybezek.eu/?p=296177 Ve středu 21. října 2026 se konalo první sportovní klání Šluknovské ligy, žáci některých výběžkových škol se utkali v Dolní Poustevně ve futsale.
Pravidelná a tradiční sportovní soutěž škol Šluknovského výběžku (dle loňských textů letos 34. ročník). A jako vždy dílčí informace od některých účastnících se škol:

Základní škola Jiříkov:

Ve středu 21. 10. 2026 byl futsalovým turnajem zahájen další ročník Šluknovské ligy. V Dolní Poustevně jsme byli první !!!. Až později dorazil do haly domácí tým a po něm zbývající 4 družstva. Tím náš velký úspěch skončil. Naši hráči se snažili trefit správné zařízení, kterému se říká branka soupeře, a nakonec se nám tato činnost dolní končetiny povedla 4x a pokaždé jinému střelci. Šancí bylo více, ale na ty se nehraje. Trochu jsme zamotali tabulkou svým jediným vítězstvím nad třetím Šluknovem, ale nakonec jsme se umístili na 6. místě. Nutno podotknout, že polovinu našeho repre týmu tvořili nováčci ze 6. třídy, pro které byla velká zkušenost hrát proti o dva až tři roky starším chlapcům. Nejdůležitější je, že si všichni zahráli, naši kluci zůstali zdraví, nikdo nebyl CHORÝ a chovali se v rámci fair-play. Za měsíc jdou do boje děvčata v přehazované, tak jim držme palce, aby naše umístění vylepšila.

J. Kolář

Šluknovská liga – futsal. ZŠ Dolní Poustevna – krásné 4. místo. Gratulujeme!

Základní škola J. Vohradského Šluknov:

První sportovní soutěží Šluknovské ligy v ročníku 2026/2027 byl, jako již tradičně, futsal.

Náš tým tvořili žáci napříč celým druhým stupněm: Kristián D., Antonín V., Matyáš H., Matyáš H., Josef B., Jakub V., G. C., David V. a Petr S.

Všem hráčům děkujeme za jejich nasazení, sportovní přístup a reprezentaci školy.

V celkovém pořadí jsme obsadili krásné 3. místo. Gratulujeme k dosaženému výsledku!

]]> Turnaj Jr. NBA League, 1. hrací kolo divize E – 21. 10. 2026 Šluknov https://www.vybezek.eu/296193-turnaj-jr-nba-league-1-hraci-kolo-divize-e-21-10-2026-sluknov/ Wed, 21 Oct 2026 21:49:30 +0000 https://www.vybezek.eu/?p=296193 Po jarní kvalifikační části (a po divizi F ve VDF) se ve středu 21. října 2026 konal turnaj dalšího ročníku Jr. NBA League ve Šluknově.

Web Schrödingerova institutu:

Ve středu 21. října se ve Šluknově odehrálo hrací kolo Západní ligy Jr. NBA, divize E, které organizačně zajistila Basketbalová akademie Šluknovska při Schrödingerově institutu.

Na palubovce se představilo pět školních týmů, které bojovaly nejen o vítězství, ale především o dvě postupová místa do další fáze soutěže.

Konečné pořadí divize E:
1. ZŠ Mozartova, Jablonec nad Nisou
2. ZŠ Vojtěcha Kováře, Rumburk
3. ZŠ Tyršova, Rumburk
4. ZŠ J. Vohradského, Šluknov
5. ZŠ Jiříkov

O druhém postupujícím rozhodoval doslova jediný bod! Obě rumburské školy odehrály vzájemný zápas s nerozhodným výsledkem 6:6 a o konečném pořadí tak rozhodoval rozdíl ve skóre ze všech utkání. Ten měla ZŠ Vojtěcha Kováře lepší o pouhý jeden bod, a zajistila si tak postup společně s vítěznou školou z Jablonce nad Nisou. Šluknovská základní škola obsadila se svým jedním vítězstvím čtvrté místo, pátý Jiříkov tentokrát na výhru nedosáhl.

Gratulujeme oběma postupujícím týmům a všem ostatním děkujeme za skvělé sportovní nasazení, bojovnost a fair play! Velké poděkování patří také všem, kteří se podíleli na organizaci turnaje, trenérům, pedagogům i rozhodčím.

Jsme rádi, že Basketbalová akademie Šluknovska může být součástí projektu Jr. NBA a přinášet dětem z našeho regionu další příležitosti zažít atmosféru opravdové basketbalové soutěže.
Basketbal nás spojuje!

Oficiální web akce je na tom stále stejně (viz minulý text), nic nic nic a ještě jednou nic. A tentokrát na tom o moc lépe nejsou ani zúčastněné školy.

Základní škola Jiříkov na FB:

Žáci ZŠ Jiříkov bojovali v juniorské NBA lize

Dne 21. 10. 2026 se žáci 2. až 5. tříd ZŠ Jiříkov zúčastnili juniorské NBA ligy, kde bojovali o postup do dalšího kola.

Přestože se jim tentokrát nepodařilo zvítězit a postoupit do užšího výběru, zaslouží si velkou pochvalu. Do hry dali všechny své síly, bojovali statečně a nevzdávali se. Ukázali své přednosti a zároveň poznali, v čem se mohou dál zlepšovat.

Zápasy jim přinesly cenné zkušenosti i motivaci do dalších tréninků. Děkujeme všem našim hráčům a hráčkám za reprezentaci školy, nasazení a odhodlání!

Přijďte strávit příjemné odpoledne na Asijskou poznávací stezku, kde společně oslavíme Slavnost světel a pro letošek stezku symbolicky zavřeme.

Rodiny s dětmi se od 15:30 mohou těšit na tvořivé dílny a kouzelnou procházku s lampiony osvětlenou stezkou. Nenechte si ujít vznik nádherného vzoru rangoli z barevného písku inspirovaného indickým svátkem světel – Díválí. Na zahřátí si můžete vychutnat šálek kořeněného masala čaje.

Dospělí návštěvníci se mohou zapojit do rozebírání jurty před zimou, vlhké zimní klima jí nesvědčí…

Přijďte s lampionem a můžete vzít i menší zavařovací sklenici na ozdobení, kterou si odnesete i se světýlkem.

Věříme, že společně strávíme příjemný podvečer. Těšíme se na vás!

Srdečně zve spolek Thonmi z.s.
